'''November 2000 Rochester tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Face the Music, Rochester, Minnesota on 4 November 2000. [[Graham Neal]] won it. It is known from Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1425">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-rochester-mn-11-4-00d1425/ rochester-mn-11-4-00], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-rochester-mn-11-4-00d1425/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Face the Music, Rochester, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Graham Neal]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Tyler Williams's report gives his final line as 8 (+28) and says Josh Coleman 'I believe' took second; Peter Jacobson's director's standings give Williams 8 (26) and list Josh Kohman 2nd (no Josh Coleman in the 24-player standings).<ref name="tr-d1425" />
* Tyler Williams's report gives his final line as 8 (+28) and says Josh Coleman 'I believe' took second; Peter Jacobson's director's standings give Williams 8 (26) and list Josh Kohman 2nd (no Josh Coleman in the 24-player standings).<ref name="tr-d1432" />
